title: regional-gpu-hour-econ-scenarios
content:
One-line summary: regional GPU-hour burn and $/1M token sensitivity for H100/A100/T4 across base / optimistic / pessimistic demand scenarios.

Purpose: Quick working sheet for infra and finance to align on reserved capacity sizing and pricing floors by region. This is an informal working sheet (notes + simple calculations).

Key assumptions (explicit):
- Tokenization: 1 token ~ 4 characters.
- Average request size used for unit economics: 500 tokens (prompt+response) for usage mix baseline.
- Throughput numbers are measured tokens per GPU-hour at our typical inference stack (batching + KV cache on). These are conservative operational averages (not peak bench).
- Pricing shown is our internal marginal infra cost per GPU-hour by region (includes infra, power, amortized host, and networking). Discounts for reserved capacity expected but not applied in base rows.
- Cache hit-rate and batching: base scenario assumes 12% KV-prefix cache hit and moderate (40%) effective batching; optimistic assumes 25% cache hit + 55% batching; pessimistic assumes 5% cache hit + 25% batching. Cache/batching are folded into the throughput numbers below.

Throughput and cost table (tokens / GPU-hour and $ / GPU-hour by region)
Columns: GPU | model class | tokens_per_gpu_hr | us-west $/hr | us-east $/hr | eu-west $/hr | apac $/hr
H100 | 13B | 40,000,000 | 24.00 | 26.00 | 30.00 | 38.00
H100 | 70B | 8,000,000  | 24.00 | 26.00 | 30.00 | 38.00
A100-80GB | 13B | 28,000,000 | 10.00 | 12.00 | 14.00 | 18.00
A100-80GB | 7B  | 56,000,000 | 10.00 | 12.00 | 14.00 | 18.00
T4 | 7B | 12,000,000 | 2.50 | 2.80 | 3.20 | 4.00

Derived metric: $ per 1M tokens = ($/gpu_hr) / (tokens_per_gpu_hr) * 1,000,000  (rounded 2dp)
GPU | model class | us-west $/1M | us-east $/1M | eu-west $/1M | apac $/1M
H100 13B | 0.60 | 0.65 | 0.75 | 0.95
H100 70B | 3.00 | 3.25 | 3.75 | 4.75
A100 13B | 0.36 | 0.43 | 0.50 | 0.64
A100 7B  | 0.18 | 0.21 | 0.25 | 0.32
T4 7B    | 0.21 | 0.23 | 0.27 | 0.33

Interpretation notes: 
- H100 running 13B is our most cost-efficient host for high-throughput generation on larger models; cost per 1M tokens remains < $1 in all regions in base assumptions.
- 70B-class models on H100 are ~5x more expensive per token because of memory/compute inefficiencies at these sequence lengths. Put differently, 70B workloads should only be used when necessary (quality delta).
- APAC is the most expensive region across the board (~25-60% higher per token) due to infra and networking premiums.

Scenario projections (next 3 months): aggregated GPU-hour burn and implied monthly token capacity per scenario.
Notes: monthly_token_capacity = total_gpu_hours * tokens_per_gpu_hr (weighted mix). For simplicity we run two representative pools: H100-13B (50% of heavy gen), A100-13B (35%), A100-7B (10%), T4-7B (5%).

Base scenario (mid adoption): expected growth +5% month-over-month.
Month | total_gpu_hours | H100-13B %hours | A100-13B %hours | A100-7B %hours | T4 %hours | implied monthly tokens (M) | est monthly infra cost ($k)
2026-03 | 18,000 | 50 | 35 | 10 | 5 | 18,000*(0.5*40 + 0.35*28 + 0.10*56 + 0.05*12)/1e6 =  (calc) 18,000*(20+9.8+5.6+0.6)/1e6 = 18,000*36.0/1e6 = 648.0M tokens -> 648 | cost: weighted regional average ~ (use us-west numbers) 18,000*(0.5*24 + 0.35*10 + 0.10*10 + 0.05*2.5) = 18,000*(12 + 3.5 + 1.0 + 0.125)=18,000*16.625=$299,250 -> 299.3k
2026-04 | 18,900 | same mix -> tokens ≈ 680M -> cost ≈ 314.2k
2026-05 | 19,845 | tokens ≈ 714M -> cost ≈ 330.0k

Optimistic scenario (aggressive caching/batching improvements, +15% MoM growth first two months):
Month | total_gpu_hours | implied tokens (M) | est monthly infra cost ($k)
2026-03 | 18,000 | 720M (effective throughput +11% due to caching) | cost ~ 285k (improved utilization, reserved discounts start)
2026-04 | 20,700 | 830M | cost ~ 325k
2026-05 | 23,800 | 960M | cost ~ 370k

Pessimistic scenario (lower batching, unexpected tail-latency causing lower concurrency, +2% MoM):
Month | total_gpu_hours | implied tokens (M) | est monthly infra cost ($k)
2026-03 | 18,000 | 600M | cost ~ 320k (inefficient mix towards H100 70B and more APAC routing)
2026-04 | 18,360 | 612M | cost ~ 327k
2026-05 | 18,727 | 625M | cost ~ 335k

Unit-economics takeaways (working):
- If average downstream charge to customers is $2.50 per 1M tokens (blended), base scenario gross margin before fixed costs is strong (>80%); pessimistic shrinks margins but still likely positive for most model mixes.
- H100-13B is the primary lever: shifting 20% of heavy gen to A100 (13B) yields immediate ~15-20% cost reduction in blended $/1M tokens for current mix.
- APAC cost premiums materially impact enterprise customers with region-specific routing; consider regional reserved pools or cross-region egress optimizations.

Risks & open questions:
- Model quantization rollouts (8-bit/4-bit) could change tokens/hr by +25-60% depending on quality tradeoffs; run controlled evals.
- Billing granularity and token accounting discrepancies between SDK and infra metering (ENG-1428) still under review; final unit numbers may shift.
- Reserved commitments: negotiation target for H100 should aim for 20-30% discount to on-demand rates to protect margins in optimistic growth.

Action items (owners):
- Aisha: run an A/B test shifting 20% heavy 13B traffic from H100 to A100-13B for 2 weeks, measure latency/quality/cost (due 2026-03-15).
- Lucas: model reserved capacity sensitivity (5/12/36 month) and produce decision matrix for finance by 2026-03-25.
- Priya: run quantization evals for 13B models (8-bit vs 4-bit) and report throughput vs quality on H100/A100 by 2026-04-05.
- Omar: validate infra metering vs SDK token counts for March usage window (ENG-1428 follow-up).

Appendix: worked example (how to calculate $/1M tokens)
- Example: H100 13B in eu-west: cost 30 $/hr, throughput 40,000,000 tokens/hr -> $/1M = 30 / 40 = 0.75 USD.

Notes to reviewers: this is a working sheet. If you paste numbers into a formal model, double-check the throughput assumptions with bench logs (serving-runtime/benchmarks) and tag the PR where changes are made.

End of sheet.
